acceptance: Baseline schema, checker and make sqlglot-repro-retirement-check support wrapper cases; malformed or missing cases still fail closed, with tests.
A unit test shows a wrapper output change fails the checker while the direct-transpile check still passes.

The checker has a QuestDB executor or a documented policy, and a test shows questdb-dialect can be flipped to fork-covered under it; a workaround path may be re-pointed or removed without the case becoming malformed.
The mysql workaround path in the baseline points at the real code.
make pr-preflight, make comment-policy-check, make compat-docs-check and make typecheck pass; PR merged.
description: scripts/check_sqlglot_repro_retirement.py calls the vendored transpile directly, so wrapper output can change while the check passes. It also rejects a pass without database execution for any target except sqlite and duckdb, and requires each workaround.path to exist, which blocks flipping questdb-dialect to fork-covered and breaks when questdb_rewriter.py is deleted. Add an 'entry' field (transpile or wrapper) plus platform and optional ddl_options to baseline cases. Wrapper cases call translate_sql_query and, once they exist, translate_ddl / apply_rewrite, and must execute on the named engine and match expected rows. Add an executor for QuestDB (container) or an explicit, tested policy for targets without a local engine. Fix the mysql-percentile-decorator workaround path (the baseline names dialect_compat.py, which has no percentile logic). Keep the README rule that retirement needs both read=<target> and read=postgres probes to pass with the helper removed.
